tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Use when the user wants an animated tour or show announcement, a gig or club-night flyer, a release announcement or countdown, a festival lineup, a lyric video, a music visualizer or a Spotify Canvas loop. Finds Motiontone templates that move to a song's beat. Returns each match with a preview image

tools.name: open_template
tools.description: Use after search_templates, once the user has picked a template or given their details. Returns a link that opens the template in the Motiontone browser editor with the user's own words (artist name, show dates, cities, venues, release title) already in its text blocks, keyed by the blockIds search_
